metadata.title: Links and singularities of stable maps from $3$-manifolds to surfaces
metadata.abstract: For any two links in the $3$-sphere, we provide a visual construction of a stable map $f$ from the $3$-sphere to the Euclidean plane such that $f$ has no cusp points, the set of definite (resp. indefinite) fold points of $f$ is isotopic to the first (resp. second) given link, and $f$ does not have a certain type of singular fibers. Moreover, we obtain a similar result for any $3$-manifold by setting the target space to the $2$-sphere.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 构造三维流形到曲面的稳定映射，使定折叠与不定折叠奇点链环可按要求指定且无尖点。
analysis.breakthrough: 在 S³ 到平面及一般三维流形到 S² 的设定中控制奇点链环。
analysis.limitations: 目标曲面与禁用奇异纤维类型需要保持原设定。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
analysis.priorityReason: 低维拓扑构造明确，潜在用途集中于奇点与链环。
